HOME.TITLE: Comfortable rides, fair fares
HOME.SUBTITLE: Discover a ride experience tailored to your needs with fair prices and drivers you can trust.
HOME.SCHIPHOL_DESCRIPTION: Mr. Taxi is ideal for vacationers. Leave your flight information with us and we'll make sure you leave on time or are picked up. No dragging your luggage on public transport. No family or friends you need to ask for help (and that in the middle of the night...). We pick you up at home or bring you safely and comfortably home. You can fill in your flight information when ordering.
HOME.ROTTERDAM_DESCRIPTION: Planning to travel by taxi to Rotterdam The Hague Airport? That's no problem at all. Mr. Taxi provides daily rides to and from Rotterdam The Hague Airport. We also offer various transport solutions to private and business customers in the region and even far beyond. Mr. Taxi specializes in rides to and from Rotterdam The Hague Airport with comfortable cars.
HOME.EINDHOVEN_DESCRIPTION: If you're flying from Eindhoven Airport soon and looking for transport to or from the airport, you've come to the right place at Mr. Taxi. We specialize in providing comfortable and affordable rides to Eindhoven Airport. From the moment you've made a reservation, we'll make sure you're picked up in a comfortable car with a reliable driver.
HOME.CTA_TITLE: Reserve now a taxi to Schiphol, Rotterdam or Eindhoven Airport
HOME.QUALIFIED_DRIVERS_DESCRIPTION: All our drivers have a driver's license and the required papers and permits. They are extensively trained in, among other things: product and street knowledge, customer friendliness, new driving and safety, and resilience and anti-aggression.
HOME.PAYMENT_METHODS_SUBTITLE: We accept all major payment methods. Pay however suits you best!
HOME.PAYMENT_METHODS_DESCRIPTION: Of course you can pay in our taxis as it suits you best. You can pay by card, but we also accept payment by credit card in all our vehicles. You can also pay via iDeal. You will receive a receipt as proof of payment if desired.
HOME.BEST_PRICES_DESCRIPTION: Mr. Taxi has the lowest rates of all taxi companies in the region. We also offer attractive discounts through various products so everyone can use our services. At Mr. Taxi you never pay too much.
HOME.ONLINE_BOOKING_DESCRIPTION: Book a taxi so you know for sure that your taxi will be present when you need it? Book and pay online easily and quickly from your office or living room. You will also receive immediate confirmation of your reservation.
HOME.REVIEW_1_TEXT: Excellent service! The driver was on time, professional, and the car was very clean. I'll definitely use Mr. Taxi again for my airport transfers.
HOME.REVIEW_2_TEXT: Best taxi service in the region. Fair prices, comfortable ride, and easy online booking. Highly recommended!
HOME.REVIEW_3_TEXT: Very reliable and professional. The driver helped with my luggage and got me to Schiphol on time. Great experience!
HOME.CASH_BENEFIT: Book 24h+ in advance and pay cash to save 5%!
